normalized_metrics.attention_pairs: seq_len^2 for non-causal attention, seq_len * (seq_len + 1) / 2 for causal attention
normalized_metrics.estimated_attention_flops: 4 * batch_size * heads * attention_pairs * head_dim, counting multiply-add as 2 FLOPs for QK^T and P/V
normalized_metrics.median_us_per_token: median latency normalized by batch_size * seq_len
normalized_metrics.median_ns_per_attention_pair: median latency normalized by batch_size * heads * attention_pairs
